 LouCity FC advances to USL Championship Final after clinching 5th Eastern Conference title 
 Louisville City FC (WDRB+WAVE) By WDRB+WAVE Digital Staff Published : Nov. 14, 2026 at 11:41 PM EST Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google LOUISVILLE, Ky. (WDRB+WAVE) — Louisville City FC is heading to the USL Championship Final after claiming the club’s fifth Eastern Conference title.
 The River City team came out on top against the Charleston Battery 2-0 Saturday, thanks to goals from Ray Serrano and Many Perez.
 “I thought we really dug deep there. We needed to against a very, very good team, a well-coached team that causes a lot of problems, and we had to fight and we had to dig in,” LouCity interim head coach Simon Bird said. “And we did that.”
 A tight defensive performance sealed the win for LouCity as they stood strong against Charleston’s 21 shots and 70.8% of possession.
 The boys in purple will hit the road to take on the winner of Sunday’s Western Conference Final between New Mexico United and Sacramento Republic FC.
